purpose: Evaluate online linear-bandit adaptation to an abrupt reward-model shift on identical synthetic candidate sets without claiming real HNSW retrieval or user evidence.

rewardModel.distribution: Bernoulli with probabilities from a clipped linear contextual model

interpretationBoundary: The simulator does not execute an HNSW index.
Candidate recall and retrieval latency are not measured.
Synthetic rewards do not establish real-user effectiveness.
This manifest defines an exploratory pilot rather than a preregistered confirmatory study.
